title: Make constitution.ng be your own.
intro: Manage your account, how you dey read, and di research wey you save.

guest.body: You dey use am as guest. You fit ask questions and save sections without account.
guest.signInBenefit: Sign in make your conversations and di sections wey you save dey every device. Anything wey you don save here go follow you.

available.title: Wetin dey here
available.unknown: We no sure whether e dey available

reading.title: Reading and asking
reading.enterToSendHint: Use Shift+Enter for new line. Ctrl/Cmd+Enter go always send.
reading.followLatestHint: Scroll go new messages when you dey near di end of di chat.
reading.openSourcesHint: For computer, open di first source wey dem link after explanation finish.
reading.syncedToAccount: Dis settings go follow your account go any device.
reading.savedOnBrowser: Dis settings dey saved for dis browser.

language.title: Language
language.official: Di official wording of di Constitution and other laws go always stay for English.
language.savedOnBrowser: Your language dey saved for dis browser.

privacy.title: Privacy and research
privacy.keptInAccount: Di sections and settings wey you save dey your account.
privacy.keptOnBrowser: Di sections and settings wey you save dey stay for dis browser.
privacy.retention: Drafts go stay for dis tab until you close am. Conversations dey stay with your account, or with dis browser for 30 days if you be guest.
privacy.provider: When explanations dey on, we dey send your question and di Constitution text wey concern am to DeepSeek make e write and check di answer. No put personal details wey you no need share.
privacy.exportFirst: Export your bookmarks, settings and di conversations wey dey before you clear di research for dis device. Source editions and citations go dey inside di export.
privacy.readMore: Read how we dey handle your data

data.title: Your account data
data.downloadBody: Copy of everything wey dey your account: your profile, sections wey you save, settings, and every conversation with di messages.
data.adminCannotDelete: Administrator account no fit delete itself. Ask another administrator make e remove dis account.
data.deleteBody: Dis one go delete your account, your conversations, di sections and settings wey you save, finish. Download your data first if you want copy.
data.confirmBody: Your account, conversations, sections wey you save and settings go delete for good. You no fit bring dem back.

clear.title: Clear di bookmarks and drafts for dis device?
clear.body: Dis one go comot your bookmarks from dis browser and drafts from dis tab. Your account and di conversations wey you save go still dey. Export your research first if you want copy.
clear.done: Bookmarks and drafts for dis device don clear
clear.confirm: Clear di research for dis device

errors.saveFailed: Your browser no fit save dis settings. Abeg try again.
errors.exportFailed: We no fit export all your research. Check your network and try again.
errors.clearFailed: We no fit clear some research for dis device. Abeg check your browser storage.

profile.confirmNewEmail: Check di new email address to confirm di change.
profile.title: Your information

verify.title: Confirm your email address
verify.body: We don send link to {{email}}. Di sections and conversations wey you save go start to sync once you confirm am.
verify.sentTo: We don send new link to {{email}}.
verify.sent: We don send new link to your email.
